countRule: Count only real files as authored frames; mirrored direction is not an additional drawing.
reducedMotion: Use first frame and static ready/needs-feed badge.
effects: Presentation events never grant inventory, coins, XP or complete jobs.
soundRule: Batch gesture emits at most one cue after successful transaction.
runtimeTimingSource: animals/<species>/animation.json is authoritative for actual FPS/duration; target recommendations in this common file do not override per-species metadata.
